title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce TrialAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and drug development decision-making using simulated trials where the truth is known, embedded within the data records of a fictional drug sponsor.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We publicly release nearly 3,500 tasks, varying from analysing a single trial to managing multi-phase programmes with budget and time constraints.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 24 closed- and open-weight models, the strongest agents can analyse raw, messy trial records to within 6% of a process-aware analysis, even when an assumption is violated, with 95% confidence intervals containing the true effect 94--95% of the time.
